access.notes: Open-source DFT package capable of GGA calculations, geometry optimization, and vibrational frequency analysis. Serves as an alternative to the proprietary ADF code used in the original paper.

resources.name: Bulk α-Al2O3 crystal structure parameters

access.notes: Lattice parameters a=b=4.7570 Å, c=12.9877 Å; internal coordinates x=0.3063, z=0.3522 from Kirfel & Eichhorn (1990). These values are well-known and are provided directly in the task instruction.

resources.notes: The crystal structure serves as the starting point for cluster construction.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials and basis sets for CP2K

access.package: GTH-PBE pseudopotentials + DZVP-MOLOPT basis sets (included with CP2K)
access.notes: Standard GTH pseudopotentials with PBE functional. Pseudo-hydrogen atoms with fractional nuclear charges (Z=1.5 and Z=0.5) may require custom pseudopotential parameters or all-electron basis sets.

resources.notes: Required for DFT calculations; the agent must set up appropriate pseudopotentials for fractional-charge pseudo-hydrogen saturators.
